title: Toothbrush with a smiling face

<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>

  <!-- eyes -->

  <path d='M42 31 Q50 38 58 31' stroke='#1565C0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='30' r='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='30' r='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.7'/>
